name: walletpassbuilder
description: Create Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes from a chat: loyalty and stamp cards, membership cards, event tickets, coupons and gift cards.

interface.longDescription:
WalletPassBuilder puts Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes in ChatGPT. Ask for a loyalty card, membership card, event ticket, coupon or gift card in your own words, and ChatGPT makes a pass that works on iPhone and Android, with one link that opens the right wallet on any phone. Apple Wallet setup is handled for you.

Used by coffee shops, salons, gyms, restaurants, clubs, event organizers, agencies and multi-location brands.

What you can do:
- Create passes: loyalty and stamp cards, membership and gym cards, event tickets, coupons, gift cards, digital business cards and staff badges, with your colors, logo, fields, QR code or barcode, and details on the back.
- Turn a PDF or screenshot into a pass: share a ticket, coupon or card and get a wallet pass with the same details and code.
- Issue cards to a list: paste a member or attendee list and get one personal card per person, each with its own link, up to 500 at a time.
- Update passes: change a whole pass or one person's card. Saved copies update automatically on every phone.
- Run loyalty programs: create a stamp card or spend-based reward with a sign-up link for your counter, add stamps or purchases, and see who has joined and their progress.
- Send lock-screen notifications: message everyone who saved a pass, now or at a scheduled time, and cancel scheduled messages.
- Archive passes and check your pass credits and workspaces.

ChatGPT shows you the exact message before any notification is sent, and asks before changing or archiving a pass.

Requirements: a WalletPassBuilder account. Connecting requires an account admin with access to every workspace. ChatGPT uses the same pass credits as the dashboard: 1 per pass created or saved to a wallet, whichever total is higher. Updates, notifications and reading your passes don't use credits.

ChatGPT can't see or change your billing, API key, team members or password, and never receives your loyalty customers' phone numbers. You can disconnect at any time from API, then Connected apps, in the WalletPassBuilder dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Create a stamp card for my coffee shop: 8 stamps for a free coffee.
Make event tickets for my workshop, one for each person on this list.
Turn my PDF ticket into an Apple Wallet pass.

positive.description: Launch a loyalty stamp card and get its sign-up link
positive.prompt: Create a stamp card for Sunset Coffee Co.: 5 stamps, a free coffee as the reward, brown background, coffee logo. Give me the sign-up link for my counter.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a loyalty pass (pass_type loyalty, reward_type visits, stamps_required 5, reward 'Free coffee') and replies with its share link and the join link customers scan to sign up.

positive.description: Issue one personal membership card per person from a list
positive.prompt: Make a Jimmy Gym membership card, black background, dumbbell logo, with name, tier and member ID on the front and a barcode of the ID. One each for: Amelia S, Premium, F93872023; John Davis, Standard, F93872024.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one generic pass using {name}, {tier} and {member_id} variables with two recipients, and returns each person's own share link. Uses two pass credits.

positive.description: Update one person's card without changing the rest of the pass
positive.prompt: On the Jimmy Gym pass, change John Davis's tier to Premium.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Jimmy Gym pass and John Davis's card, then updates only his tier value. Other recipients and the design are unchanged, and the change reaches phones that saved the card.

positive.description: Send a lock-screen message only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Tell everyone with the Sunset Coffee card: 'Double stamps all weekend!'
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the exact message and which pass it goes to and asks for confirmation. Only after the user says yes does it call send_notification and report that it was sent.

positive.description: Answer account questions from read-only tools
positive.prompt: Which passes are live, how many customers joined the Sunset Coffee card, and how many pass credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists live passes with their share links, reports the loyalty program's customersJoined count and the remaining credit balance. No data is changed.

negative.description: Payment requests are out of scope
negative.prompt: Charge my customer Sarah $4.50 for her coffee and add it to her card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that WalletPassBuilder can't take or process payments. It may offer to record a stamp or purchase on her loyalty card instead, but doesn't charge anyone.

negative.description: Customer phone numbers are never exposed
negative.prompt: Give me the phone numbers of everyone who joined my Sunset Coffee loyalty program.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that phone numbers aren't available through the app. It can list customers' names and progress with list_loyalty_customers, but never returns phone numbers.

negative.description: Billing and account settings can't be changed
negative.prompt: Upgrade my WalletPassBuilder plan to the yearly subscription and change my account password.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that billing, plans and passwords can't be viewed or changed from ChatGPT and points the user to the WalletPassBuilder dashboard. No tools change anything.

publication.release_notes: Clearer description of what the app does, new starter prompts, and the listing in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Italian.

es-ES.subtitle: Pases de Apple y Google Wallet
es-ES.description: Crea pases para Apple Wallet y Google Wallet desde ChatGPT: tarjetas de fidelidad y de sellos, tarjetas de socio, entradas para eventos, cupones, tarjetas regalo y tarjetas de visita digitales. Describe la tarjeta con tus palabras y ChatGPT crea un pase que funciona en iPhone y Android, con un solo enlace que abre la cartera correcta en cada teléfono. Convierte un PDF o una captura de una entrada en un pase, crea una tarjeta personal para cada persona de una lista, actualiza los pases ya guardados y envía notificaciones a la pantalla de bloqueo. Necesitas una cuenta de WalletPassBuilder.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pass Apple et Google Wallet
fr-FR.description: Créez des pass Apple Wallet et Google Wallet depuis ChatGPT : cartes de fidélité et à tampons, cartes de membre, billets d'événement, coupons, cartes cadeaux et cartes de visite numériques. Décrivez la carte avec vos mots et ChatGPT crée un pass qui fonctionne sur iPhone et Android, avec un seul lien qui ouvre le bon portefeuille sur chaque téléphone. Transformez un billet en PDF ou une capture d'écran en pass, créez une carte personnelle pour chaque personne d'une liste, mettez à jour les pass déjà enregistrés et envoyez des notifications sur l'écran verrouillé. Un compte WalletPassBuilder est nécessaire.

de-DE.subtitle: Apple & Google Wallet-Pässe
de-DE.description: Erstelle Pässe für Apple Wallet und Google Wallet direkt in ChatGPT: Treue- und Stempelkarten, Mitgliedskarten, Eventtickets, Gutscheine, Geschenkkarten und digitale Visitenkarten. Beschreibe die Karte in eigenen Worten, und ChatGPT erstellt einen Pass für iPhone und Android, mit einem Link, der auf jedem Handy die richtige Wallet öffnet. Mach aus einem PDF-Ticket oder Screenshot einen Pass, erstelle für jede Person auf einer Liste eine eigene Karte, aktualisiere gespeicherte Pässe und sende Mitteilungen auf den Sperrbildschirm. Du brauchst ein WalletPassBuilder-Konto.

pt-BR.subtitle: Passes Apple e Google Wallet
pt-BR.description: Crie passes para Apple Wallet e Google Wallet no ChatGPT: cartões de fidelidade e de carimbos, carteirinhas de sócio, ingressos para eventos, cupons, vales-presente e cartões de visita digitais. Descreva o cartão com suas palavras e o ChatGPT cria um passe que funciona no iPhone e no Android, com um único link que abre a carteira certa em qualquer celular. Transforme um ingresso em PDF ou uma captura de tela em passe, crie um cartão pessoal para cada pessoa de uma lista, atualize passes já salvos e envie notificações para a tela de bloqueio. É preciso ter uma conta WalletPassBuilder.

it-IT.subtitle: Pass Apple e Google Wallet
it-IT.description: Crea pass per Apple Wallet e Google Wallet da ChatGPT: carte fedeltà e a timbri, tessere associative, biglietti per eventi, coupon, carte regalo e biglietti da visita digitali. Descrivi la carta con parole tue e ChatGPT crea un pass che funziona su iPhone e Android, con un solo link che apre il wallet giusto su ogni telefono. Trasforma un biglietto in PDF o uno screenshot in un pass, crea una carta personale per ogni persona di un elenco, aggiorna i pass già salvati e invia notifiche alla schermata di blocco. Serve un account WalletPassBuilder.
